estimates: The model covers the museum wings, their connecting passage, the entrance and the garden-facing courts. Nearby churches and the Roman towers have separate identities.
The current building footprint follows the mapping. Wing heights, window spacing, stair shape, court locations and court floor grades are estimates based on the written architectural history.
Medium-fi geometric motifs represent the recessed shell and medallions, with simplified timber latticework. The original inscriptions and sculpture are beyond this exterior model.

review.notes: Reviewed the published Qualla image set first. The portrait of Pahor and Patriarch Yousab II provides no identifiable reference for the exterior. Modern architectural imagery was excluded. Native mapping and primary written architectural records establish the reconstruction.
